blocks.text: CAMP GEN. MARIANO N. LLANERA, Nueva Ecija — At least 400 police officers from the Nueva Ecija Police Provincial Office (NEPPO) have been deployed to the National Capital Region (NCR) to augment security forces for the 2026 Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) Summit, police said Saturday, Nov. 14. A send-off ceremony was held at the provincial police office’s covered court on Nov. 13, led by NEPPO director Col. Rochiel Claravall. The officers will reinforce security operations for the summit scheduled on Nov. 16 to 18 at the Philippine International Convention Center in Pasay City, police said.
